message: The other day, a storm was brewing outside, and I found myself rummaging through the closet for candles and flashlights, only to stumble upon an old deck of cards. Remember those? It turned into a cozy evening of rummy with the grandkids, complete with laughter and a few friendly arguments over the rules. Sometimes, when the weather gets wild, it’s nice to rediscover the simple joys of low-tech fun. What’s your favorite way to pass the time when the storm keeps you inside? ☔️
